raw_text: Great editor overall (4/5 stars). Only real complaint is that the Git diff view is nearly unreadable in dark mode. The added/removed line colors are too similar.
The extension marketplace is excellent but search needs improvement (3/5 stars). Too many similar extensions make finding the right one difficult.
Absolutely love the Copilot integration (5/5 stars). It's changed how I code. Would be perfect if latency was lower on slower networks.
Been using VS Code for 3 years and it keeps getting better (4/5 stars). Only minor complaint is that some UI options are hard to find.
Good editor with solid features (2/5 stars). Extension host crashes are a major issue that have caused me data loss. Needs better stability.
Really solid choice for development (5/5 stars). The customization options are endless and the community is very supportive.
